In frames 3–4, the camera wearer turns and approaches the scooter until its seat and front body dominate the foreground within arm’s reach, with the red-clothed adult about 1–2 m beyond it and partly cut off above; the seat occludes much of the driveway and lower surroundings. By frame 5, the viewpoint has rotated toward the scooter’s handlebars and instrument panel, still within arm’s reach, while the green-shirted child stands roughly 1–2 m ahead-left of the scooter, facing generally toward it and partly cropped at the top.
